# Project state table

Derived from `config/<region>/**/delinks.txt` via `tools/progress.py`'s own
parser, so these figures cannot drift from the real metric. Re-derive rather
than inherit: every campaign wave that trusted a handed-down count found it wrong.

## Readable C by region

`natural-C` is hand-written readable C — the headline figure, and the one to
quote. `asm-C` is inline-asm coverage hygiene, counted separately on purpose.
`C-decompiled` is their sum; do not conflate it with natural-C.

## EUR data typing

| metric | bytes | of data bytes |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typed-array | 161,052 | 3.37% |
| Named-struct | 54,736 | 1.15% |
| *(total data bytes)* | 4,776,528 | |

`Typed-array` counts any file-scope array declaration, including opaque
`unsigned char[N]` carve placeholders — it is a coverage metric, not a
correctness one. `Named-struct` excludes primitive-typed arrays by design.
Read `summarize_data_readability` before reasoning about either.
